baseline.commit_message: revert: remove delegated task from main

audit.runtime_test_reason: No local project checkout was available; outbound GitHub DNS/network access was unavailable in the execution environment.
audit.latest_baseline_ci_evidence: No workflow runs were associated with the audited main commit.

confirmed_failures: A2-01 JSON filename/payload run_id mismatch is not rejected.
A2-02 SQLite row-key/payload run_id mismatch is not rejected.
A2-03 malformed JSON container shapes can escape as AttributeError instead of SessionRepositoryError.
A2-04 reconstructed SessionRecord values bypass M31 validation and session ownership checks.
A2-05 InMemorySessionRepository exposes live mutable SessionRecord instances.
positive_controls: A2-07 JSON writes already use sibling temp file plus os.replace().
A2-08 JSON path construction rejects separators, NUL, CR, and LF.
A2-09 repository/manager locking is instance-local and M28 documents single-process/low-contention JSON scope.
A2-11 workflow state transitions remain centralized and human gates remain in RuntimeCoordinator.

design_limitation.sqlite_pickle: SQLiteSessionRepository uses pickle and is explicitly trusted-storage-only; attacker-controlled database files are out of scope for a security guarantee.

non_goals_preserved: No new workflow states or phases.
No changes to human approval gates.
No new persistence provider or service.
No multi-process transactional guarantee for JSON.
No claim that SQLite/pickle is safe for attacker-controlled storage.
